pretreatments.description: Mechanical pretreatment involving debarking, cutting, and grinding (milling) of pine wood, followed by screening to achieve a relatively homogeneous size of less than 1 mm (20 mesh).
Alkali pretreatment involving sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution at 8% w/w concentration, incubating at 0°C or 100°C for varying durations of 10, 30, or 60 minutes.
